# chargebee_item_entitlement (Resource)

Grants a feature to an item (plan, addon, or charge) via Chargebee's Item Entitlements API. Chargebee's upsert is idempotent, so an entitlement already present in Chargebee is adopted into state and its value updated to match this configuration on the first apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Switch feature: granted with the default value "true".
resource "chargebee_item_entitlement" "standard_sso" {
  item_id    = chargebee_item.standard.id
  item_type  = chargebee_item.standard.type
  feature_id = chargebee_feature.sso.id
}

# Quantity feature: the value is the granted amount.
resource "chargebee_item_entitlement" "standard_rate_limit" {
  item_id    = chargebee_item.standard.id
  item_type  = chargebee_item.standard.type
  feature_id = chargebee_feature.api_rate_limit.id
  value      = "600"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_id` (String) Id of the granted feature. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `item_id` (String) Id of the item the feature is granted to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `item_type` (String) Type of the item: `plan`, `addon`, or `charge`. Must match the item's type. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `value` (String) Entitlement value. For a switch feature use `true` (the default); quantity and range features carry a numeric value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `item_id:feature_id`.
